body: Implemented: built-in blueprints (ui-component, header, footer, form, page, service, api-endpoint, login) plus project blueprints in .pman/blueprints/ with extends/override; pman blueprint list/show/suggest/apply/status/skip/unskip/check/init; child tickets carry origin {blueprint,item}; coverage (planned/done/not needed/missing/undecided) in pman check warnings, pman context and the new Checklist section in the ticket view (preview with checkboxes, create, 'Not needed' with reason, undo). Tests in test/blueprints.test.js; docs in README and implementation-decisions.
author: local
